Learn to craft an outdoor knife from recycled steel salvaged from light truck leaf springs. This hands-on workshop teaches traditional metalworking techniques.

【Fee】
¥8,000 per person (includes guide, insurance, materials)

【Capacity】
10 people

【Guide】
Staff of Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop (認定NPO法人名栗カヌー工房)

【What to bring】
• Safety goggles (dust protection)
• Rubber gloves or leather work gloves (hardware store brands are fine)
• Lunch

【More information】
Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
